description.trigger: Workflows can be triggered by events in Zoho Campaigns such as: New Campaign creation, New Contact addition, or Unsubscribe actions.
description.integration: Workflows in Zoho Campaigns can be initiated when new campaigns are created, new contacts are added, or when subscribers unsubscribe from mailing lists.

ai_description.trigger: Zoho Campaigns supports marketing automation actions such as Add/Update Contact, Clone Campaign, Create Campaign, Send Campaign, Find Campaign, Find Contact, Find or Add a Contact, Find or Create a Campaign, and Unsubscribe.
ai_description.integration: Zoho Campaigns is an email marketing automation platform that helps businesses create, send, and track targeted email campaigns. It enables managing mailing lists, designing campaigns, automating engagement workflows, tracking campaign performance, and maintaining subscriber health.
